Question 6
?
x 0 1 2 3 4
y 6 4 3 1 −1

Find the line of the form y=β0+β1x that best fits the data above.

Hint: You can use the fact that (XTX)−1=110[6−2−21],XTy=[139], where X is the corresponding design matrix and y is the observation vector.

a
y=6−1.7x
b
y=−1.7−6x
c
y=−1.7+6x
d
y=1.7−6x
e
y=−6+1.7x
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The coefficients of the line that best fits the data can be found as the least-squares solution β^ to the system

[1011121314]⏞X[β0β1]⏞β=[6431−1]⏞y,

where X is the design matrix, β is the parameter vector, and y is the observation vector.

Pre-multiplying this equation by XT, we obtain the corresponding normal equation

XTXβ^=XTy.

Since the columns of X are linearly independent, the matrix XTX is invertible and

β^=(XTX)−1XTy.

Substituting the given values of (XTX)−1 and XTy into the formula, we get

β^=(XTX)−1XTy=110[6−2−21]⋅[139]=[6−1.7].

Therefore, we have the line y=6−1.7x.

[1616.516.517]⏞X[β0β1]⏞β=[581010]⏞y,
